competency_statement_fil: TESDA BHS NC II — Participate in Workplace Communication: nakukuha at naipapaabot ng BHW ang tamang impormasyon sa lugar ng trabaho, nagagampanan ang tungkulin ayon sa tagubilin, at nakukumpleto ang mga dokumentong kaakibat ng gawain — sa tatlong tungkuling bumubuo sa kanyang papel bilang HEPO ng barangay.
competency_statement_en: TESDA BHS NC II — Participate in Workplace Communication: the BHW obtains and conveys relevant workplace information, performs duties following instructions, and completes the documents the work requires — across the three roles that make up their work as the barangay's HEPO.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Naipapaliwanag ng BHW, gamit ang sariling salita, na mas malawak ang tungkulin niya kaysa paghatid ng serbisyo dahil ang direksyon ng UHC ay primary care at health promotion — at nakapagbibigay siya ng halimbawa ng gawaing hindi paghatid ng serbisyo.
observation_indicators.observable_en: The BHW explains, in their own words, that their role is wider than service delivery because UHC's direction is primary care and health promotion — and gives an example of work that is not service delivery.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Nailalarawan ang trabaho bilang listahan lamang ng serbisyo (pagtimbang, pagbabakuna, pag-refer), at kapag tinanong tungkol sa UHC ay nasasabi lang na 'libre na ang PhilHealth' nang hindi naiuugnay sa sariling tungkulin.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Describes the work as a list of services only (weighing, immunisation, referral), and when asked about UHC says only 'PhilHealth is free now' without connecting it to their own role.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Kusang binabanggit ang health promotion at pag-oorganisa bilang bahagi ng tungkulin, may kasamang halimbawa mula sa sariling barangay.
levels.kaya_na_en: Brings up health promotion and organising as part of the role unprompted, with an example from their own barangay.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Nasasabi ang mas malawak na tungkulin kapag tinanong, pero serbisyo pa rin ang unang naiisip.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: States the wider role when asked, but service delivery is still the first thing that comes to mind.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Nananatiling paghatid ng serbisyo lamang ang paglalarawan kahit may untag tungkol sa UHC.
levels.hindi_pa_en: The description stays at service delivery even when prompted about UHC.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Nasasabi at nailalarawan ng BHW ang tatlong tungkulin — Health Educator, Community Organizer, Health Service Provider — at kung ano ang ginagawa sa bawat isa, nang hindi tumitingin sa materyal.
observation_indicators.observable_en: The BHW names and describes the three roles — Health Educator, Community Organizer, Health Service Provider — and what each involves, without looking at the material.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Nasasabi ang pangalan ng tatlo pero hindi mailarawan ang pagkakaiba ng ginagawa sa bawat isa, o pinagsasama ang Health Educator at Community Organizer sa iisang paglalarawan.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Names the three but cannot describe how what they do differs, or collapses Health Educator and Community Organizer into a single description.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Tatlo ang nasasabi nang tama, may sariling paglalarawan sa bawat isa na magkakaiba.
levels.kaya_na_en: Names all three correctly, with a distinct description of each in their own words.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Dalawa ang malinaw na nailalarawan; ang pangatlo ay kailangan pa ng untag.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Describes two clearly; the third needs prompting.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Isa lamang — kadalasan ang Health Service Provider — ang naiuugnay sa sariling trabaho.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Connects only one — usually Health Service Provider — to their own work.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Sa isang ibinigay na sitwasyon sa barangay, wastong natutukoy ng BHW kung aling tungkulin ang ginagampanan, at nakapagbibigay siya ng katulad na pangyayari mula sa sariling karanasan.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Given a barangay situation, the BHW correctly identifies which role is being performed, and offers a comparable event from their own experience.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Natutukoy ang tungkulin sa mga halimbawang galing sa modyul, pero walang maibigay na pangyayari mula sa sariling barangay; o sinasabing 'hindi ko trabaho iyan' sa sitwasyong nasa saklaw ng tatlong tungkulin.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Identifies the role in the module's own examples but offers nothing from their own barangay; or says 'that's not my job' about a situation that is within the three roles.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Tama sa lahat ng sitwasyon, at may kusang ibinibigay na sariling halimbawa para sa bawat tungkulin.
levels.kaya_na_en: Correct on every situation, and volunteers an example of their own for each role.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tama sa halos lahat, pero isang tungkulin lang ang may sariling halimbawa.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Correct on most, but has an example of their own for only one role.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Nalilito sa pagitan ng tatlo, o iisang tungkulin lang ang itinuturo anuman ang sitwasyon.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Confuses the three, or names the same role regardless of the situation.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Nabibilang ng BHW ang mga talaang hawak niya (household profile, master list, registry, mga form ng DOH o LGU) at nasasabi kung kanino napupunta ang bawat isa at para saan ito ginagamit.
observation_indicators.observable_en: The BHW lists the records they keep (household profile, master list, registry, DOH or LGU forms) and states where each one goes and what it is used for.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Nabibilang ang mga papeles pero inilalarawan ang mga ito bilang 'requirement' o 'para sa midwife' lamang, nang hindi naiuugnay sa direksyon ng programa.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Lists the paperwork but describes it as a 'requirement' or 'for the midwife' only, without connecting it to where a programme is directed.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Nabibilang ang mga talaan at naipapaliwanag kung paano nakakaapekto ang datos sa pagpili ng prayoridad ng programa.
levels.kaya_na_en: Lists the records and explains how the data affect which priorities a programme takes on.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Nabibilang ang mga talaan at alam kung kanino ipinapasa, pero hindi pa naiuugnay sa paggamit ng datos.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Lists the records and knows who they go to, but does not yet connect them to how the data are used.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Isa o dalawang talaan lamang ang naaalala, at itinuturing na papeles na walang kinalaman sa serbisyo.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Recalls only one or two records, and treats them as paperwork unrelated to service.
